actions.reason: Cache decoded text results for list/tuple id sequences on tokenizer instances, keyed by the current vocabulary and special-token mappings. Repeated decodes of the same token sequences avoid rebuilding byte chunks and decoding them again while preserving cache invalidation when tokenizer mappings change.
